claims.statement: POST /webhook/alertmanager keeps only firing alerts, runs each through ReasoningFlow.run, and records each report via record_external_incident, with the Alert.target derived from labels in priority order pod, deployment, statefulset, service, job, instance.

A webhook test verifies that posting the sample Alertmanager payload returns a report with a symptom, ranked hypotheses, and suggested next steps, and that a manually posted incident appears in the incidents list.

The event watcher acts only on the named fault reasons in KubeEvent.FAULT_REASONS (CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff, ErrImagePull, FailedScheduling, Unhealthy, FailedMount, NodeNotReady, Evicted), scopes to events whose object is already a graph node, deduplicates by event UID, and drops events older than event_max_age_minutes.
Status-based detection raises an incident for a pod that stays unhealthy across status_unhealthy_rebuilds consecutive graph rebuilds even with no fresh event, and setting the value to 0 disables it.

The GET /debug/detection endpoint exposes the watcher's last-poll gate counters (events_seen, events_403, matched_fault_reason, dropped_stale, out_of_scope, already_seen, event_incidents, status_incidents, unhealthy_pods) so that 'no incidents' is self-diagnosing.
Tests verify the event watcher behavior and the webhook path, including that auto-detected and manually posted incidents share one incident timeline.
